mainEntity.name: Are walk-in showers worth it in bathroom remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in showers are often worth it if you want easier access, a more open look, and less maintenance than a bulky tub-shower combo. They can also make a bathroom feel larger, especially in tighter layouts. If resale is a concern, consider whether your home benefits more from a shower-only space or keeping at least one tub elsewhere.
